title: Synthesis and application of a bimetallic-MOFs with sulfonic acid tags in preparation of biologically active nicotinonitriles via cooperative vinylogous anomeric-based oxidation
content:

The catalytic application and antibacterial properties of MIL-88B(Fe2/Ni)/imidazole/SO3H as a bimetallic catalyst was investigated in the synthesis of new nicotinitriles with antibacterial properties.
